gen-gf-esteban-gf-lexend-exa: Refined and bookish, Esteban lets its thinner curve tops and tall middle zone do the talking. Lexend Exa follows in wide, stubby-ascender sans, each curve staying distinct, and if you made the heading tiny it would lose that quiet polish.
gen-gf-esteban-gf-lexend-giga: Esteban has the restrained swell of a round brush barely pressed. Lexend Giga, a flat, single-weight sans-serif with generous tracking, gives a longer passage a spacious, unhurried feel with every word clearly separated.
gen-gf-esteban-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega looks drawn with a single nib, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals and every c showing a visible gap. Esteban is better at refined, bookish serif detail; Mega at steady, approachable clarity.
gen-gf-esteban-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta reads smoothly, its big x-height and wide-mouthed c shapes sliding under the eye like wire without any thinning. Over a long passage it stays approachable, while Esteban's lighter horizontals add a bookish contrast.
gen-gf-esteban-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera reads like a plotter pen drew it, single-weight and open-faced, with letters spaced like stepping stones. Give it a bit more size than Esteban's heading needs, since its texture rewards room.
gen-gf-esteban-gf-lexend-zetta: Slim crossbars up top, ribbon-cut strokes below, and a clear split between the two. Esteban is best at refined, bookish detail in its thinner strokes; Lexend Zetta is best at wide, approachable tracking.
gen-gf-esteban-gf-montserrat-alternates: Esteban brings refined, bookish serifs whose thin strokes never turn spindly, with a tall middle zone. Montserrat Alternates, a sans-serif cut from one gauge of tubing, feels rounder and more contemporary beside it.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code spaces its letters out so widely you can hardly ignore it, with a wire-like monoline skeleton. Euphoria Script, relaxed and close-fitting, softens that with casual pen strokes, and the two make a lively, loose pairing.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono stands its letters like pins in a wide board, curves as thick as stems, and capitals blending into a compact skyline. And Euphoria Script, graceful and handwritten, loosens the whole look beside it.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-gf-graduate: Casual pen-and-paper letters that fit close together give Euphoria Script its relaxed, graceful hand. Graduate, a dignified serif with plenty of white between letters, takes a slightly larger size to stay comfortable.
